newsitem.title: FRANCE: French historian Francois Furet dies.
newsitem.headline: French historian Francois Furet dies.

text.p: Historian Francois Furet, a leading contemporary writer on the 1789 French Revolution, died at the weekend following an apparent stroke suffered while playing tennis, state radio said on Monday. He was 70.
A banker's son, Furet was a militant communist until 1956 when he broke with the party over the Soviet intervention which crushed the Hungarian uprising.
He was best known for his "Critical Dictionary of the French Revolution" which refuted Marxist interpretations of the events which preceded and followed the fall of the monarchy.
Furet also wrote extensively about contemporary Communist regimes.
